headline: A 1998 executive order directs federal action to protect coral reefs in U.S. waters.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses on protecting coral reefs. Only the title was provided, so the specific rules and duties it creates are not described here. Executive orders like this one usually direct federal agencies on how to carry out their work.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies whose work involves or affects coral reefs are likely directed to take steps to protect them.
